snippet.title: The Spirit Engine longplay
snippet.description:
This is a simple no-commentary playthrough of The Spirit Engine (2003). The editing is very light - which means the playthrough honestly shows deaths and a few cases of me going back to do some level-grinding.

I'm sorry about the audio issues, for the first about two thirds of the game most UX sounds are doubled.

We're playing v105, an officially endorsed fan patch from 2024.
